families.label: Primary Agriculture and Forestry Production
families.definition: Direct production and primary handling of crops, livestock, timber, and agricultural commodities before advanced manufacturing or consumer preparation.

capabilities.label: Crop production
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to cultivate, harvest, handle, and manage commercial field, orchard, greenhouse, or specialty crop production systems.

capabilities.label: Livestock production
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to breed, raise, feed, manage, and market livestock or animal products through commercial production systems.

capabilities.label: Timber production
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to establish, manage, harvest, and supply commercial timber resources through controlled forestry and land operations.

capabilities.label: Agricultural commodity handling
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to receive, grade, aggregate, condition, store, trade, and transfer bulk agricultural commodities before downstream processing.
